dataset.title: Benthic images recorded by a Remotely Operated Vehicle video camera during cruise JC241 in the eastern Clarion-Clipperton Zone (Pacific Ocean, 2023)
dataset.description: Video collected by the UK ISIS remotely operated vehicle during the 2023 JC241 cruise in the eastern Clarion-Clipperton Zone, including abyssal seafloor and disturbance associated with a 1979 mining trial.
dataset.description_scope: dataset; individual video contents have not been reviewed
dataset.citation: Fleming, B.; Van Audenhaege, L.; Simon-Lledo, E.; Jones, D. (2025): Benthic images recorded by a Remotely Operated Vehicle video camera during cruise JC241 in the eastern Clarion-Clipperton Zone (Pacific Ocean, 2023). NERC British Oceanographic Data Centre, 11 February 2025. doi:10.5285/2de087c9-cee3-87f4-e063-7086abc0f9a9.

datasets.name: MammAlps
datasets.description: Forest and alpine wildlife camera footage, including nighttime scenes. Sample stored AI descriptions mention deer, marmots, grazing and animal movement.
datasets.description_scope: Summary of indexed upload metadata and sampled AI-generated descriptions; individual media and species identifications have not been independently reviewed.
datasets.provenance_status: Original download source, dataset revision, licence and citation not yet recovered; identity confirmed by indexed dataset tags and location.

ingestion.count_scope: Fully indexed parent uploads visible to the workshop account, including pilot and quality-test uploads. Counts do not establish distinct original recordings or completeness of the source dataset. Tag counts overlap.

verification.method: Live database-backed VSS retrieval API: dashboard segment counts and paginated Explore records, authenticated and ACL-filtered.

datasets.name: KABR
datasets.description: Savanna wildlife footage, including aerial views. Sample stored AI descriptions mention giraffes and zebras grazing and walking; indexed uploads include RGB and thermal footage.
datasets.description_scope: Summary of indexed upload metadata and sampled AI-generated descriptions; individual media and species identifications have not been independently reviewed.
datasets.provenance_status: Original download source, dataset revision, licence and citation not yet recovered; identity confirmed by indexed dataset tags and location.

ingestion.count_scope: Fully indexed parent uploads visible to the workshop account, including pilot and quality-test uploads. Counts do not establish distinct original recordings or completeness of the source dataset. Tag counts overlap.

verification.method: Live database-backed VSS retrieval API: dashboard segment counts and paginated Explore records, authenticated and ACL-filtered.

settings.custom_prompt: Describe visible seabed habitats, sediment, rocks, organisms, vehicle tracks, furrows and other visible disturbances. Read legible on-screen annotations. Separate observations from possible explanations; do not infer mining causes or historical dates unless explicitly shown.

storage_verification.method: S3 HEAD: file size and stored ingest metadata; custom prompt URL-decoded
